## Bootstrap file

The file of the relay proxy, `version: 2`. File: `.schema/bootstrap-schema.json`. Reload says what a reload of the file does with the key: `live` applies it in place, `restart` keeps it out until the next start and names it in `pendingRestart`.

## Manifest

Document of kind `Manifest`, written last by `semaphore-cli publish`. File: `.schema/manifest-schema.json`.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `apiVersion` | string | yes |  |  | APIVersion is the document version, "semaphore/v1". Empty means the current version when marshalling. |
| `channel` | string | yes |  |  | Channel names the channel (environment) of the manifest. |
| `createdAt` | string |  |  | format date-time | CreatedAt is informational. |
| `generation` | integer | yes |  |  | Generation increases strictly with every publication of a channel, starting at 1. |
| `kind` | string | yes |  |  | Kind is "Manifest". Empty means "Manifest" when marshalling. |
| `objects` | list of object | yes |  |  | Objects are the source objects. |
| `objects[].checksum` | object | yes |  |  | Checksum is the checksum of the exact stored bytes. |
| `objects[].checksum.algorithm` | string | yes |  |  | Algorithm is AlgorithmSHA256. |
| `objects[].checksum.value` | string | yes |  |  | Value is the lower-case hex digest. |
| `objects[].connection` | string | yes |  |  | Connection names a connection of the relay bootstrap file; it fixes endpoint, bucket and credentials. |
| `objects[].format` | string | yes |  |  | Format is FormatYAML, FormatJSON or (flags only) FormatTOML. |
| `objects[].key` | string | yes |  |  | Key is the key of the object in the bucket of the connection. |
| `objects[].kind` | string | yes |  |  | Kind is KindFlags, KindFlagSets or KindSegments. |
| `objects[].name` | string | yes |  |  | Name is the logical name, unique in the manifest; flag sets reference objects by it. |
| `objects[].size` | integer | yes |  |  | Size is the size of the stored bytes. |
| `objects[].version` | integer |  |  |  | Version is the version of the content schema; 0 means ObjectVersion1. |
| `objects[].versionId` | string |  |  |  | VersionID is an optional object version id of the store. |

## Flag-set document

Document of kind `FlagSet`. File: `.schema/flagset-schema.json`.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `apiVersion` | string | yes |  |  | APIVersion is the document version, "semaphore/v1". Empty means the current version when marshalling. |
| `flagSets` | list of object | yes |  |  | FlagSets are the flag-set definitions. |
| `flagSets[].apiKeys` | list of string |  |  |  | APIKeys are plain inline keys (UUIDs). They are secrets: never log them. |
| `flagSets[].name` | string | yes |  |  | Name is the unique name of the flag set. |
| `flagSets[].segmentSources` | list of string |  |  |  | SegmentSources are names of manifest objects of kind segments; the segments that the rules of this flag set name with segment("name") are defined there. A name must be defined once in all the sources of a flag set. |
| `flagSets[].sources` | list of string | yes |  |  | Sources are names of manifest objects of kind flags; a later source wins on a duplicate flag key. |
| `kind` | string | yes |  |  | Kind is "FlagSet". Empty means "FlagSet" when marshalling. |

## Segments document

Document of kind `Segments`. File: `.schema/segments-schema.json`.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `apiVersion` | string | yes |  |  | APIVersion is the document version, "semaphore/v1". Empty means the current version when marshalling. |
| `kind` | string | yes |  |  | Kind is "Segments". Empty means "Segments" when marshalling. |
| `segments` | list of object | yes |  |  | Segments are the definitions. |
| `segments[].cache` | object |  |  |  | Cache sizes the cache of a lookup segment. |
| `segments[].cache.maxEntries` | integer |  |  |  | MaxEntries is the most cached answers. |
| `segments[].cache.ttl` | string |  |  |  | TTL is how long an answer is cached, a duration such as "30s". |
| `segments[].connection` | string |  |  |  | Connection names a connection of the relay bootstrap file: a dynamic segment. |
| `segments[].key` | string |  |  |  | Key is the key of the set (layout set) or the prefix of the member keys (layout keys) in the store. |
| `segments[].layout` | string |  |  |  | Layout is "set" (default) or "keys". The keys layout is lookup only. |
| `segments[].members` | list of string |  |  |  | Members are the members of a static segment. An empty list is a static segment with no member. |
| `segments[].missingKey` | string |  |  |  | MissingKey is "notMember" (default) or "unknown": what a segment that does not exist in the store means. |
| `segments[].mode` | string |  |  |  | Mode is "snapshot" (default) or "lookup" (dynamic only). |
| `segments[].name` | string | yes |  |  | Name is the name that rules use: segment("name"). |
| `segments[].onError` | string |  |  |  | OnError is what a lookup that could not be answered becomes: "notMember" (default), "unknown" or "member". |
| `segments[].version` | object |  |  |  | Version says how the version of the segment is learned (dynamic only). |
| `segments[].version.interval` | string |  |  |  | Interval is the poll period of Key, a duration such as "5s" (needs Key). |
| `segments[].version.key` | string |  |  |  | Key is the version key in the store. |
| `segments[].version.value` | string |  |  |  | Value is a version that the document carries. |
